svg.title: PCB strain reconstruction: method and direct finite element verification
svg.desc: Working-manuscript evidence. An invariant measured influence library is combined through support compatibility and strain-tensor superposition. The nontrivial G001 and G004 two-mount layout, with all reference mounts removed, agrees with direct finite element fields to an RMSE of 9.5 times ten to the minus four microstrain. A layout evaluation is reported as 0.92 seconds in the draft. Arbitrary-position interpolation and its spatial sampling campaign remain ongoing.
svg.text: PCB STRAIN / A REUSABLE MODEL WITH DIRECT FE EVIDENCE
Change the supports. Reconstruct the field.
Measured influence responses become a fast, mechanically consistent layout evaluation.
NONTRIVIAL CHECK / ALL REFERENCE MOUNTS REMOVED
Discrete-layout agreement is demonstrated; the spatial sampling and unseen-position validation remain in progress.
Working manuscript · Figure 3 and Sections 5.1–5.5 · Method schematic and original FE comparison.
